notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Forgive back-to-back updates to resolve some bugs and add a significant feature.

[b]What's in this update?[/b]
-Saving during Battle Prep is now possible
-Fixed a bug preventing Tadhg's epilogue from appearing correctly
-Fixed a bug causing Niamh to be absent in new game plus
-Fixed a bug preventing Pól's name from appearing correctly
-Characters now gain bonuses in new game plus based on choices throughout the game

Saving during Battle Prep has been a long requested feature, and I've finally resolved the issue. I hope this leads to less frustration in losing time spent managing units.

Report any bugs you encounter, and send me your thoughts and feedback: cbrayf@gmail.com


Yours,
CB

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
[b]What’s in this update?[/b]
-Clear, concise tutorials now occur on Story difficulty in Chapters 1 and 2 that better teach players the basic mechanics of the game
-Secondary characters now have death quotes on Balanced and Challenge difficulty
-If [spoiler]Tadhg checks on Niamh in Chapter 2, and in Chapter 4, Tadhg says, “I have to leave,”[/spoiler] Niamh and Tadhg’s support is no longer completely erased; their support is simply decreased by one to their base support level
-In Chapter 4, the southeastern home now provides a weapon based on the available weapon types of the unit who uses the “Search” command
-New Glacier Rod staff available from an enemy in Chapter 10
-The accuracy formulas of Silence, Stun Baton, Hexing Rod, and Glacier Rod staves have been drastically simplified to the user’s Mag, Skl, Lck, or Res (different for each staff) multiplied by 5; these staves each now have an increased number of uses as well
-Save reminders after battle preparations are now optional based on a choice at the beginning of Chapter 3
-The Flame Sword weapon is only earned upon completing the game if the player did not own one previously (if any player currently has a save file with more than one Flame Sword, they’re grandfathered in and will keep however many they have)
-Misc bug fixes

If you've checked out the game and haven't left a review, please consider doing so! Reviews are essential to getting the game in the hands of more folks!

Hope you're doing well and staying safe in the world.

Yours,
CB

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
[b]What's in this update?[/b]
-Added prompts to save on turn 1 after battle prep
-Armored units (the Knight, Holy Knight, and Raider classes) now receive 3 less damage when their HP is full.
-New Gold Knife weapon for Thief and Assassin classes only
-New spell effects for Gust, Gale, Tornado, Sky Dance, and Soul Lantern weapons
-New weapon icons for Blaze, Meteor, Gust, Gale, Bolt, Tempest, Radiance, Illuminate, Purify, and Judgment

I'm hoping the buff to armored units makes them more interesting to face and improves the versatility of the newest secondary character added in the last patch: Rune. ([url=https://brayfieldwriting.com/walk-with-the-living-ii-character-guide]Check the official guide[/url] for information on how to recruit him, or find him on your own.) As of this patch, no two weapons share an icon or (other than physical weapons) animation anymore.

If you haven't yet, please consider reviewing the game! Getting to [b]10 reviews[/b] greatly improves the chances of Steam recommending the game.

Improved controller and Steam Deck functionality are still a work in progress; thanks for your patience! I know these are features that people really want to see.

Reach out to let me know what other features you'd like to see!

Yours,
CB

notes.title: Update

Thanks to him for his playthrough and his quite nice dramatic reading of the first few chapters! :)

-Fixed some missing enemy portraits in Chapter 2 at the siblings' home
-Fixed "Fang" weapon remaining in Deirdre's inventory if she finishes Chapter 2 with it
-Buffed Deirdre's stat bonuses when transformed
-Fixed ally units in Chapter 3 keeping dropped loot

[b]What's next?[/b]
-Better controller support (currently, both the first and second game use DirectInput which supports some controllers better than others; however, there are options for controller input directly through Steam that I'm exploring)
-Ability to view item info when on the loot screen
-Everything mentioned in yesterday's update

Thanks for your continued support!

Yours,

notes.title: Update and Official Guide
notes.content:
[b]What's in this update?[/b]
-Misc bug fixes (fixed achievements not triggering correctly, etc.)
-Presentation improvements like cleaner transitions between phases, etc.
-Increased unit deployment by 1 on all maps after Chapter 4, mostly to allow for further flexibility in new game plus, but it could be taken advantage of by industrious players on their first playthrough ;)

The [url=https://brayfieldwriting.com/walk-with-the-living-ii-character-guide]official guide[/url] for the game is now released! Check it out if you'd like to plan your first playthrough!

To those who've already purchased the game, I appreciate your support! If you've enjoyed the game, [b]consider leaving a review[/b] as soon as you're able. It really boosts the game's visibility on Steam and gives confidence to prospective players.

[b]What's next?[/b]
-More balancing and bug fixes as needed
-Still working on adding more story interactions with secondary characters, including epilogues, for both the sequel and the first game
-Longer, multi-stage side story chapters accessible outside of the main story (the first of these likely won't drop for a few months yet)

I feel really fortunate to have the support of a lot of awesome people behind me. Truly, I'm endlessly grateful for each of you <3

Yours,
CB
